ayahs.en: Have you seen him who denies the Requital
So, he is the one who pushes away the orphan
and does not persuade (others) to feed the needy

ayahs.te: కావున నమాజ్ చేసే, (ఇటువంటి) వారికి వినాశం తప్పదు
ayahs.en: So, Woe to those performers of Salāh

ayahs.te: ఎవరైతే తమ నమాజ్ ల పట్ల అశ్రద్ధ వహిస్తారో
ayahs.en: who are neglectful of their Salāh
who (do good only to) show off
and refuse (to give even) small gifts
